answer_1.quote: Recent text generation models (TGMs) based on the transformer architecture have demonstrated impressive capabilities of creating texts which are very close to human in terms of fluency, coherence, grammatical and factual correctness.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on detecting artificially generated texts rather than generating text per se, but it addresses the broader context of text generation models (TGMs) and their capabilities in producing human-like text.
